methodology: Post-hoc temperature scaling on validation split; ECE computed via 10-bin histogram

baseline_metrics.notes: Overconfident model (confidence > empirical accuracy in high-confidence bins)

temperature_scaling.method: Optimize T to minimize NLL on validation logits

reliability_diagrams.description: Plots confidence (x-axis: predicted probability bins 0.0-1.0) vs. empirical accuracy (y-axis). Diagonal = perfect calibration. Before: above diagonal (overconfident). After: closer to diagonal.

clinical_implications.overconfidence_before: Model reports 80% confidence but only 65% correct in that bin
clinical_implications.after_scaling: Reported confidence better matches true accuracy; suitable for downstream uncertainty quantification in clinical workflows

limitations: T learned on validation; generalization to held-out test assumed
Single scalar T applied globally; per-class calibration not done (future work)
CheXpert validation set size (~668 * 0.15 ≈ 100 images) is small; T estimate has variance
